title: Fill book details from photos
description: Photograph or upload the front cover and, when useful, the back cover. AI will propose the eight catalog fields; you review every value before saving. The catalog cover remains a separate manual upload.
catalog_found: This book is already in the catalog. Add your listing details.
privacy: Photos are sent securely to OpenAI only when you press this button.
front_required: Add a clear front-cover photo first.
back_required: Add a clear back-cover photo before analysis.
not_book: These photos do not clearly show a book. Use clear photos of the front and back covers.
success: Book information was added to the form. Review every field before saving.
failed: The photos could not be analyzed. Check your connection and try clearer photos.
front_help: Upload a clear photo of the front cover.
back_help: Upload a clear photo of the back cover.
drop_or_choose: Take a photo or choose from gallery
reading_description: Our AI is analyzing the images and extracting the book information. This usually takes a few seconds.
please_wait_help: Our AI is working hard to recognize your book. This usually takes a few seconds.
tips_description: Take clear, well-lit photos of the front and back cover. Make sure the text is visible and the image is not blurry.
tip_clear: Make sure the text is clear and readable
tip_whole_cover: Include the whole cover in the photo
